title: The Famous Door closes and Leeman takes kitchen items
summary: The club's management tells the band to take what they want before receivership, and Leeman takes pots and a meat cleaver.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: About then, things were slowing down on the street financially for the owners of clubs, and we closed The Famous Door; it was closing after many years. And the management came up and told us, 'Look, we're closing, we can't afford to keep open and so I thought I'd tip you off

before we foreclose. If you want anything in the kitchen or anything in the club, when we close Saturday night, take whatever you can get out without anybody noticing, and you're most welcome to take it, because this thing is going into a receivership."

And that's all I had to hear, because if they had another kitchen like the Three Deuces, it would thrill me to pieces. And I couldn't see how I could -- a couple of ten gallon pots I could get in my bass drum case, and I had my eye on something that I always wanted, which was a meat cleaver. And I've got it here in the kitchen sitting beside me right now. I've used it over the years.
